build_CallStackGraph: build a CallStackGraph from a trace DataFrame to reconstruct CPU call stacks for a single thread
create_CallStackNode: create a CallStackNode with parent, depth, height, device type, and children list attributes
sort_events: sort a numpy array of trace events using the custom _less_than comparison function
dfs_traverse_CallStackGraph: run a depth-first traversal on a CallStackGraph calling enter and exit callbacks on each node
get_paths_to_leaves_CallStackGraph: get all paths from a given node to leaf nodes in the CallStackGraph
